card.name: Clock times in event timestamps
card.fires_on: The space after "at" or the digits and colon inside a clock time, just before a.m./p.m. or minutes. Seen in news reports of events and in page timestamps.

modes.label: Space after "at" before a time
modes.description: The gap right after "at" where an hour number is expected.

modes.label: Inside the hour or minutes
modes.description: A digit or colon within a time such as 10:24 PM, where p.m./a.m. is likely to follow.
